data.context: In the 2024 report *Raising the Bar reforms: Measuring the impact on relative patent scope*, Appendix E examines a robustness check using multinomial categories of patent scope. It describes machine-learning estimates of the proportions of Australian patents that were narrower, similar or broader than their overseas equivalents for examination requests from 2000 to 2019, around the 2013–2014 Raising the Bar reforms.
